A note from my heart

To my jaan,

Happy Birthday, meri princess. ❤️

I wanted to make you something you could open whenever you miss me—or whenever you just need a little reminder of how loved you are.

You make ordinary moments feel special. Your smile, your little ways, your care, and simply having you in my life mean more to me than I can explain.

Today, I hope you feel celebrated, appreciated, and loved in every possible way. May this year bring you peace, beautiful surprises, success, and all the happiness your heart deserves.

And selfishly, I hope I get to be part of many more birthdays, memories, silly conversations, hugs, and beautiful little moments with you.

If I were beside you right now, your birthday wish would begin with the biggest hug. 🫂

I love you, Shraddha. Always. ♡
